question: Can controller-bound seed-varied normal eligibility safely enable the R18 release predictor for the known 7.22 kg miss without relaxing physical floors or MARGIN?

sequence.meaning: conditional release eligibility with the unchanged R17C per-age predictor
sequence.normal_data: 18 live D-controller training episodes; six entire tuples x three JTS seeds
sequence.blind_data: eight disjoint tuple/seed live normal episodes, first and only independent normal evaluation for this lane

sequence.meaning: compact 24-knot normal-only predictor after V1 showed the old predictor invalid
sequence.normal_data: same 18 training episodes; 864 coefficient/envelope parameters, not a per-tick fit
sequence.blind_data: the same eight V1 tuples were now exposed development controls; not independent evidence

decision.reason: V2 retained output parity because physical floors blocked the prediction breaches, but its time-resolved normal prediction exceeded the unchanged 1.25 margin in 7/8 exposed controls. Eligibility alone is not valid force detection evidence.

next_experiment: Do not tune on the eight exposed controls. Freeze a new model class before any new normal tuple/seed: model continuous normal uncertainty directly (rather than maximum-bin envelopes), then use entirely new tuples/seeds once. Only if every time-resolved normal ratio stays <=1.25 may the known impact diagnostic open.
